## 🧪 Verification Checklist

- [ ] Tested in both French (FR) and English (EN) languages.
- [ ] Tested responsive layouts (Mobile and Desktop).
- [ ] Verified Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) boundaries.
- [ ] No secrets, passwords, or service role keys are exposed.
